notes.AIA-RISK-01: Only parsed CV text is scored (src/hireright/api.py ParsedCV); the docstring explicitly states emotion recognition/video analysis is not supported. No Art. 5 practice.
notes.AIA-RISK-02: README.md 'Regulatory position' and docs/risk-assessment.md classify the system as high-risk under Annex III 4(a) and reject the Art. 6(3) derogation.
notes.AIA-RISK-03: docs/risk-assessment.md risk register R-01..R-06 with likelihood, impact, mitigation and residual risk.
notes.AIA-DATA-01: DATASHEET.md documents composition, splits, origin/original purpose, preparation steps, assumptions and gaps.
notes.AIA-DATA-02: DATASHEET.md section 5 and MODEL_CARD.md 'Fairness': bias examination not yet performed (HR-412); removing protected fields (model.py REDACTED_FIELDS) is not a bias examination.
notes.AIA-DOC-01: docs/technical-documentation.md follows Annex IV: purpose, versions, interactions, deployment form, hardware, UI, methods, design choices, architecture, validation.
notes.AIA-DOC-02: MODEL_CARD.md: intended/out-of-scope use, version, training data, evaluation table, limitations.
notes.AIA-DOC-03: docs/instructions-for-use.md has provider contact, intended purpose and oversight measures, but sections 4 (performance/limitations) and 5 (logs) are 'TBD'.
notes.AIA-TRA-01: model.py returns top-5 SHAP contributions as reasons; web/src/components/CandidateRanking.tsx shows them to recruiters.
notes.AIA-WRK-01: docs/privacy-notice.md tells candidates 'We use an AI system to rank applications'.
notes.AIA-REC-01: Every ranking and human action is written by DecisionJournal.record(...) (src/hireright/journal.py, api.py) with model version, input digest, result, actor, timestamp; sample logs/decision-journal-2026-10-01.jsonl. No plain logger call is used.
notes.AIA-REC-02: config/retention.yaml decision_journal.retention_days: 400 on S3 Object Lock (ADR 0002).
notes.AIA-HUM-01: POST /applications/{id}/override and /decision in api.py, recorded in the journal; 'Move' action in CandidateRanking.tsx.
notes.AIA-HUM-02: POST /admin/ranking/suspend (suspend_automated_ranking) stops automated ranking and routes to the manual queue; documented in instructions for use.
notes.AIA-HUM-03: Status only changes via the recruiter /decision endpoint with a written reason; the ranker never rejects.
notes.AIA-ACC-01: MODEL_CARD.md evaluation table (ROC-AUC 0.87, NDCG@10 0.71, P@10 0.64) ships with the system.
notes.AIA-ACC-02: model.py catches inference failures and returns an unranked application for manual review ('Fallback: never guess').
notes.AIA-SEC-01: Pydantic models with patterns, ranges and max lengths (api.py ParsedCV, ScoreRequest).
notes.AIA-SEC-02: All routes use Depends(get_current_recruiter)/require_role (auth.py: OIDC JWT + roles).
notes.AIA-QMS-01: docs/release-process.md covers change management, pre-release validation, post-market monitoring and incident reporting.
notes.AIA-QMS-02: tests/test_model_quality.py asserts ROC-AUC >= 0.85 and NDCG@10 >= 0.68 on the frozen hold-out.
notes.GDPR-TRN-01: docs/privacy-notice.md: controller/DPO, purposes, legal basis, recipients, retention per category, rights incl. complaint.
notes.GDPR-RET-01: config/retention.yaml (CV 30 d, profile 180 d then anonymised, journal 400 d without CV content) enforced by retention.py CronJob.
notes.GDPR-ERA-01: DELETE /candidates/{id} erase_candidate_data deletes CV, profile and rankings (api.py).
notes.GDPR-ADM-01: No solely automated decision: recruiters decide (api.py /decision, privacy notice).
notes.GDPR-ADM-02: Privacy notice 'How the ranking works' explains main factors and that recruiters decide.
notes.GDPR-PBD-01: model.py REDACTED_FIELDS removes identity/protected fields before features; journal stores only SHA-256 digests; datasheet hashes ids.
notes.GDPR-SEC-01: Journal S3 writes with ServerSideEncryption aws:kms (journal.py); encrypted gp3 StorageClass with KMS key and TLS ingress/uvicorn TLS (infra/k8s/deployment.yaml).
notes.GDPR-SEC-02: OIDC auth + role checks on every route; privacy-officer role for erasure (auth.py, api.py).
notes.GDPR-ROPA-01: No record of processing activities in the repository.
notes.GDPR-DPIA-01: No DPIA document although candidates are systematically evaluated by automated processing.
notes.ACME-01: CandidateRanking.tsx notice: 'AI-suggested ranking ... You, the recruiter, make the final decision'.
notes.ACME-03: DecisionJournal entries with timestamp, entry id, model_version, input digest, output, actor; 400-day retention on Object Lock (WORM).
notes.ACME-04: Raw CVs deleted after 30 days by retention.py CronJob (config/retention.yaml raw_cv.retention_days: 30).
notes.ACME-05: KMS encryption for journal and volumes; TLS on ingress and app (infra/k8s/deployment.yaml).
notes.ACME-06: All inference/admin endpoints authenticated, admin routes require screening-admin / privacy-officer roles.
notes.ACME-07: Rejections only via recruiter /decision with written reason; reviewer sees score and reasons and can override; recorded in the journal.
notes.ACME-08: MODEL_CARD.md covers intended/out-of-scope use, version, training data, metrics, limitations, owner.
notes.ACME-10: docs/release-process.md 'Incident reporting' with 24h reporting to ai-incidents@acme.example.
notes.ACME-11: No bias/fairness evaluation; model card says it has not been completed (HR-412).
